title: L1A Card Deck
description: One module's curated note cards: content/<tier>/cards/<NN>-<slug>.json, e.g. content/emt/cards/02-airway.json. This is the deck that ships with the module, laid out and ordered. Custom decks the learner builds on the fly are assembled in memory from these same records and are never written back here. Cards whose id does not begin with this file's module_id do not belong here.

module_id.description: Module this deck belongs to: TIER-MM. Every card id here starts with it.

tier.description: Matches the content/ subfolder name and the module file's tier.

cards.description: The cards, inline. Print order is card.number where set, otherwise array order.
